voice.speaker: athena-as-mentor
voice.caption: Go with him, Telemachus, and sleep at the king's house. But I will back to the ship, to hearten the crew, for I am the one old man among them; and at dawn I go on to the Cauconians, where a debt is owed me, no new thing and no small one.

voice.speaker: nestor
voice.caption: Dear boy, no fear that you prove base or weak, when gods walk beside you so young, and that was no other of the Olympians but the daughter of Zeus himself, the glorious grey-eyed one who honored your father among the Argives. Be gracious, mistress: grant fair fame to me, to my children, to my honored wife, and I will sacrifice to you a yearling heifer, broad-browed, unbroken, her horns wrapped in gold.
